prerequisites: Students must have completed at least 120 ECTS of their degree program.
Students who have completed the entire degree program or who have already graduated cannot participate.

learning_outcomes.text: Contribute to the comprehensive training of students, complementing their theoretical and practical teachings.
Facilitate knowledge of the appropriate work methodology for the professional reality in which students will operate as graduates, contrasting and applying acquired knowledge.
Prepare students for the development of teamwork.
Promote the development of students' decision-making capacity and critical thinking.

assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 0.5 * Internship Report Grade + 0.5 * Monitoring Grade. A minimum of 4 points must be obtained in both the Internship Report Grade and the Monitoring Grade to pass the subject. The final grade must be 5 or higher to pass the subject. If the minimums for the Internship Report Grade and/or Monitoring Grade are not met, the maximum final grade will be 4 points. Extraordinary calls will follow the same procedure as the ordinary ones.
bibliography: Agreement of October 14, 2014 (BOPA 31-X-2014), of the Governing Council of the University of Oviedo, approving the regulation of external internships of the University of Oviedo.
